correctness.rationale: The literal hypothesis is vacuous, and the two-fold amplification of B(H) gives a unital linear map satisfying it while inducing a proper injective *-endomorphism of the Calkin algebra. The block projection/flip witness proves non-surjectivity directly. The same map preserves Kasparov cycles bidirectionally and essential spectra exactly.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The source is a recent v1 preprint; searches by title, arXiv identifier, terminology, and equivalent Calkin-amplification formulations found no prior correction or equivalent counterexample. The underlying amplification construction and standard definition are classical, but their application to this defect was not located.

value.rationale: The counterexample invalidates three principal equivalence theorems as literally stated, identifies the standard corrected quotient-surjectivity hypothesis, gives a direct repair of the Kasparov-cycle theorem, and isolates a separate false equality claim about the compact ideal.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
